title: Warm Yeasty Polish Date Flatbread
description: A traditional Polish flatbread featuring yeasty dough, crispy crust, and sweet pitted dates, perfect for a hangover cure or a satisfying snack. This recipe incorporates anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients like dates and beurre-monte.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add the warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large rectangle.
Brush the dough with olive oil and sprinkle the chopped dates evenly over the surface.
Fold the dough in half lengthwise and brush the top with beurre-monte.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until it is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
